children.title: Discover services | EOSC Scholarly Commons Node
children.main_text: Services for the scholarly commons . 7 services from trusted providers, for institutions, funders, research teams and individual researchers. Start from a task, or filter your way in. Search I want to… Plan my data DMP templates, funder requirements, machine-actionable output Publish & preserve Repositories with DOIs, versioning and long-term custody Work with metadata Graph dumps, citation data, APIs and SPARQL endpoints Monitor open science Dashboards and indicators for projects, institutions, countries All services 7 results Show All Open to anyone Set up for your organisation Open Access Argos Plan your data management: Create, link and share Data Management Plans Develop and publish your Data Management Plan on the cloud. Manage Data Researchers, Research Projects, Research Communities, Research Organisations, Funders, Businesses Openaire Details Order required OpenAIRE CONNECT Custom Gateway for your Community OpenAIRE CONNECT is a platform‑as‑a‑service that empowers research communities to create and manage customised Community Gateways. Discover Research Communities, Research Infrastructure Managers, Research Projects, Research Organisations Openaire Details Open Access OpenAIRE Graph An intelligent gateway to scholarly communication The OpenAIRE Graph is a collection of interlinked research objects that aggregates metadata records from more than 70K scholarly communication sources from all over the world for researchers, service providers, research managers and policy makers, by following a participatory approach. Discover Providers, Research Communities, Research Groups, Research Infrastructure Managers, Research Managers, Research Organisations, Innovators, Businesses, Provider Managers Openaire Details Open Access OpenAIRE MONITOR Personalised research monitoring OpenAIRE MONITOR is a service that produces well-documented, timely and accurate monitoring indicators of research activities for funders, research initiatives and organisations, by creating personalised and on-demand online configurable dashboards. Assess Funders, Research Infrastructure Managers, Research Organisations Openaire Details Open Access OpenAIRE PROVIDE One-stop-shop for sharing, improving, and enriching your content OpenAIRE PROVIDE is the scholarly gateway that receives content registration requests and provides guidance for content providers by viewing a personalised, user-friendly dashboard that shows the necessary steps and status of the services to complete the process. Outreach Providers, Provider Managers Openaire Details Open Access OpenAIRE UsageCounts Measure.Track Open Access repositories usage UsageCounts is an OpenAIRE service for content providers, research funders and policy makers, that collects and visualises usage activity of Open Access Repositories by using automated and standardised scientific methods. Assess Provider Managers, Research Managers, Resource Managers, Providers, Research Infrastructure Managers Openaire Details Open Access OpenPlato The e-learning Hub for Open Science training experiences. OpenPlato is a modular learning platform developed by OpenAIRE to support training in Open Science, Research Data Management, and related topics across Europe. Support & Train Researchers, Providers, Policy Makers, Research Communities, Research Groups, Research Projects, Research Organisations, Research Networks, Funders Openaire Details Refine Clear Category Assess Outreach Discover Interoperability Manage Data Support & Train Provider Openaire Target user Research Organisations Providers Research Communities Research Infrastructure Managers Funders Provider Managers Research Projects Businesses Research Groups Research Managers Researchers Innovators Policy Makers Research Networks Resource Managers Maturity TRL 9 Order type Open Access Order required Refine Clear Category Assess Outreach Discover Interoperability Manage Data Support & Train Provider Openaire Target user Research Organisations Providers Research Communities Research Infrastructure Managers Funders Provider Managers Research Projects Businesses Research Groups Research Managers Researchers Innovators Policy Makers Research Networks Resource Managers Maturity TRL 9 Order type Open Access Order required
